detail.title: Intex 32" HD Google TV | LED-GV3207
detail.overview: Experience cinematic entertainment in your living room with a 32-inch HD frameless screen. This Smart TV boasts a vibrant 16.7 million color display and wide color gamut for stunning visuals. Enjoy immersive audio with 24W of powerful sound and Dolby Digital technology. Chromecast built-in lets you stream your favorite content seamlessly, while hotkeys for Netflix, Prime Video, and YouTube provide quick access to popular apps.
